bullets: More than 35 Christian families in Pakistan displaced by mob violence, a believer's home and livelihood destroyed, and a man facing a death sentence upheld by the Supreme Court under blasphemy laws, with a minor boy allegedly kidnapped and coerced into conversion.

Christians in Nigeria killed, kidnapped, and held for ransom by armed militants and Fulani attackers, including a pregnant woman, an infant, and family members of church workers, amid ongoing rural violence and a state curfew.

House church members and leaders in China facing imprisonment, detention, sealed meeting places, and denial of the right to worship outside state-approved systems, with eight believers still detained after more than a year.
Christian communities in Syria suffering repeated armed mob attacks, displacement, and fear following escalating interfaith tensions.
Twelve believers in Algeria arrested during a worship service raid and facing potential prosecution for gathering in an unauthorized religious assembly.
Christian converts in Somalia and Uganda facing violent retaliation from family and community members for leaving Islam, including confinement, physical assault, and a fatal attack.
A Coptic believer in Egypt detained by security forces under contempt of religion charges for social media activity, with the broader community facing suppression of religious expression.
Cuban believers facing state conviction and judicial control restricting their movement and public witness for their faith.
Twenty Armenian Christian prisoners in Azerbaijan reportedly denied access to Bibles and subjected to religious humiliation and denial of basic rights.
A Christian community in Canada mourning the deliberate destruction of a century-old church building by arson.
Believers in the United States facing legal consequences for public prayer in solidarity with persecuted Christians abroad, amid concerns for religious liberty in public spaces.
Millions of Ukrainian civilians — including children — killed, wounded, and displaced by waves of drone, missile, and bomb strikes on homes, energy infrastructure, and cities
Residents of Gaza facing ongoing airstrikes, acute food insecurity, and humanitarian crisis one year into a fragile ceasefire
Civilians and airport workers in Saudi Arabia caught in missile strikes on civilian airports and a foiled midair suicide attack on a passenger aircraft
Families and communities across Nigeria facing militant attacks, kidnappings, banditry, and human trafficking across multiple states
Tens of thousands of Sudanese civilians — including women and children — killed, displaced, and uncounted amid drone strikes, mass atrocities, and communications blackouts
Civilians in Yemen caught in intense ground fighting and missile strikes along the Red Sea coast with heavy casualties on all sides
Families in Myanmar — including hundreds of Christian households — displaced by consecutive military airstrikes on villages and homes
Civilians in Ethiopia caught between armed conflict in two regions, including Eritrean ground forces and federal military drone strikes
Congolese civilians in remote northern areas facing attacks and abductions by armed militants beyond the reach of peacekeepers
Residents of Lebanon and Syria near the shared border caught in cross-border strikes and ongoing militant activity
Two million people in Guinea-Bissau living under military rule with no clear path to democratic elections
Afghan women and girls detained and threatened for dress code violations amid ongoing restrictions on their basic freedoms
Kurdish residents in Syria caught in security crackdowns and civil tensions between competing authorities
Iraqi security forces and civilians in areas facing recurring armed attacks by militant groups
Fishing communities in Ecuador grieving five crew members killed in a nighttime armed attack at sea
Communities in Colombia and Ecuador living amid escalating cartel violence and counter-narcotics military operations
Families of law enforcement officers killed or critically wounded in an ambush in the United States, and a young child detained alongside his wounded father during an immigration arrest
Foreign nationals in South Africa targeted by looting, arson, and violence during anti-migrant unrest
Students and families caught up in prolonged school protests in France, with hundreds injured and thousands arrested
Hijab-wearing schoolgirls in Azerbaijan barred from classrooms under new government dress code enforcement
Soldiers, civilians, and a child wounded in a military ambush in the southern Philippines
A nation in Haiti grieving the loss of a community leader amid relentless gang violence
Civilians in Mexico living near areas of escalating cartel drone warfare and improvised explosive device activity
Residents of a mountainous region in Iraq facing repeated armed militant attacks on security posts
Families across the Philippines, Lebanon, and surrounding regions living with the daily threat of armed violence and displacement
Turkey's border region workers and truck drivers affected by a deadly landslide that struck a parking area, killing at least one person.
Philippines communities facing multiple simultaneous crises — families killed and displaced by a landslide, and thousands at risk from continued volcanic eruptions.
Russia's researchers and quarantined contacts exposed to an undiagnosed fatal pneumonia, and communities along the Ob River facing prolonged drought and disrupted access to water.

Millions of residents across the United States Gulf Coast and southern states facing deaths, mass power outages, evacuations, storm surge, and wildfires from concurrent hurricane and fire emergencies.
Residents along Mexico's Pacific coast facing a powerful hurricane bringing life-threatening winds, storm surge, and catastrophic flooding.
Firefighters and communities in China's northern forest regions battling a weeks-long wildfire threatening lives and livelihoods.
Chile's coastal and capital communities facing a combination of a significant earthquake near Easter Island and flash floods and mudslides causing injuries and displacement.
Panama's Pacific coast communities reeling from a magnitude 7.7 earthquake, aftershocks, building collapses, tsunami warnings, and widespread evacuations.
More than three million residents across Thailand facing ongoing deadly flooding that has killed dozens and displaced families across dozens of provinces.
Over 35,000 unvaccinated children in Nepal displaced by flooding and now unreachable for measles vaccination, facing compounding health risks.
Kenya's health workers and hundreds of contacts under quarantine in the critical early days of the country's first confirmed Ebola death.
Critically endangered orangutans and wildlife in Indonesia's Borneo forests facing habitat destruction from spreading wildfires, alongside communities threatened by offshore earthquakes.
Canada's wildfire-affected communities facing one of the country's worst fire seasons, with millions of hectares burned, lives lost, and tens of thousands evacuated.
